title: 第4章 乃香嫂子的担忧-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “李青山，你……你这话说的可是真的？”赵贵眼前一亮，连忙将钱抓在手里道。

    有了这钱，自家儿子的手，可就能保住了。

    “少废话，先签个欠条，等到这房子去乡公所过户完了后，欠条就自动作废。”

    “怎么样？”

    李青山望着赵贵道。

    “行行行！”

    “你说怎么弄都行！”

    赵贵哪里会不同意，现在只要能救他儿子，干什么都行，连忙问李虎取了纸笔来，与李青山签了合同。

    “赵贵，现在这房子是我的了，限你五天之内找好地方搬走！”李青山望着手中的字据，脸上闪过一抹激动和兴奋道：“走吧，咱们先去乡公所办理过户！”

    “行行行，都听你的！”

    赵贵当即随着李青山一起，先回了一趟家拿自己的证件，又去了一趟乡公所，准备将房子的过户办理过来。

    乡公所距离石溪村还是有些路程的。

    这一来一回，加上办事情，恐怕等到回来的时候，快要天黑了。

    土坯房

    但是。

    李青山今日在赵贵家发生的事情，却迅速在整个石溪村内传开了。

    屯子里的二流子。

    用自家新房子做抵，向李虎借了三十六块钱，买了赵贵家的那一间破屋。

    都说赵强子赌博是个败家子，这李青山也差不到哪里去，这可是要多花好几块钱，一样的败家子。

    这事情，自然也传到了李青山爷爷，李老屯的耳朵里。

    “什么？”

    “你说李青山那小狼崽子，抵了我家的新房子去借钱？”

    李老屯顿时被气的吹胡子瞪眼，浑浊的眼神中满是怒气，声音洪亮道。

    那房子，可是给自己大孙子娶媳妇用的。

    什么时候给了他李青山？

    虽说，这房子是李青山和小儿子出了大力气，但自己不也给他们吃喝了吗？

    还能白吃白喝不成？

    “李老屯，你还不知道啊，现在全村人都传开了，借据都给人家李虎写了。”

    站在村头大树下乘凉李老屯的老对头，赵有田开口戏谑道。

    “这该死的小狼崽子，看我回去不抽死他！”

    李老屯骂骂咧咧的急忙朝着家中赶去，然而李青山早就偷拿了户口簿去乡公所了。

    ……

    这一趟去乡公所办理房屋过户很顺利，三天后程序就能走完，把土地房产所有证发下来，自己再去乡公所去取便是了。

    “赵贵，等到证件下来，咱们就两清了！”

    “这几天，你得赶紧找个地方搬走，否则可别怪老子不客气。”

    走到村口后。

    李青山望着眼前的赵贵，开口警告道。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Li Qingshan, you...are you telling the truth?" Zhao Gui's eyes lit up and he quickly grabbed the money in his hand.

With this money, my son’s hand can be saved.

"Stop talking nonsense, sign an IOU first. Once the house is transferred to the township office, the IOU will be automatically voided."

"How's it going?"

Li Qingshan looked at Zhao Guidao.

“Okay, okay, okay!”

"You can do whatever you want!"

How could Zhao Gui disagree? As long as he could save his son, he would do anything. He quickly asked Li Hu to get some pen and paper and signed a contract with Li Qingshan.

"Zhao Gui, this house is mine now. You have five days to find a good place to move!" Li Qingshan looked at the paper in his hand, a flash of excitement on his face and said: "Let's go, let's go to the township office to handle the transfer of ownership first!"

“Okay, okay, I’ll listen to you!”

Zhao Gui immediately followed Li Qingshan, first went back to his home to get his own documents, and then went to the township office to prepare for the transfer of the house.

The township office is still some distance from Shixi Village.

    这一来一回，加上办事情，恐怕等到回来的时候，快要天黑了。

Adobe house

But.

What happened to Li Qingshan at Zhao Gui’s house today quickly spread throughout Shixi Village.

A second-rate boy from the countryside.

Using his new house as collateral, he borrowed thirty-six yuan from Li Hu and bought the dilapidated house of Zhao Gui's family.

    都说赵强子赌博是个败家子，这李青山也差不到哪里去，这可是要多花好几块钱，一样的败家子。

This matter naturally reached the ears of Grandpa Li Qingshan and Li Laotun.

"What?"

"You said that little wolf Li Qingshan came to my new house to borrow money?"

Li Laotun was so angry that he blew his beard and stared, his cloudy eyes full of anger, and his voice was loud.

That house is for his eldest grandson to get a wife.

When did you give him Li Qingshan?

Although Li Qingshan and his youngest son put a lot of effort into this house, didn’t he also give them food and drink?

Can you still eat and drink for free?

"Li Laotun, you don't know yet. Now the whole village has spread the news, and I have written the IOU to Li Hu."

Zhao Youtian, Li Laotun’s old enemy, stood under the big tree at the head of the village enjoying the cool air and said jokingly.

“This damn little wolf, let’s see if I don’t beat him to death when I get back!”

Li Laotun cursed and hurried home, but Li Qingshan had already stolen the household registration book and went to the township office.

……

This trip to the township office to handle the house transfer went smoothly. The procedure will be completed in three days. The land and property ownership certificates will be issued and you can go to the township office to pick them up.

"Zhao Gui, when the certificate comes out, we will be settled!"

"In the past few days, you have to find a place to move quickly, otherwise don't blame me for being rude."

After walking to the entrance of the village.

Li Qingshan looked at Zhao Gui in front of him and warned.
